law_text: When authorized markers, buttons, or other indications are placed within an intersection indicating the course to be traveled by vehicles turning thereat, no driver of a vehicle shall disobey the direction of such indications.

alternatives_and_boundaries: Authorized intersection indications must actually exist and indicate a turning course.
